# @washy-washy/core

> Chart parsing, machine validation, and mixing rules for washy-washy, a
> laundry chart generator. Pure logic only — no rendering or file I/O — shared
> by the CLI, the web app, and @washy-washy/pdf.

Two entry points: `@washy-washy/core/browser` (everything except CSV
parsing, safe for a browser bundle) and `@washy-washy/core` (the full API,
for Node/Bun reading a CSV from disk). Every exported function and type
carries a TSDoc comment with a runnable example.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/washy-washy-core/modules.html): generated TypeDoc reference, one page per exported function, type, and interface.
- [Browser entry point](https://alrayyes.github.io/washy-washy-core/modules/browser.html): the `@washy-washy/core/browser` module — everything except CSV parsing.
- [Node/Bun entry point](https://alrayyes.github.io/washy-washy-core/modules/index.html): the `@washy-washy/core` module — the full API, including CSV parsing.
- [Architecture](https://alrayyes.github.io/washy-washy-core/media/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the modules fit together.

## Project

- [README](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-core#readme): install instructions, usage examples, and the two-entry-point explanation.
- [Source](https://github.com/alrayyes/washy-washy-core): the GitHub repository.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@washy-washy/core): the published package.
